package rulefixtures

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
)

// scenario for response_dto_outside_transport_package: Response envelope structs that live in persistence or repository packages instead of transport or API contract packages.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.

type UserRepository struct{}

type UserResult struct {
	ID        int    `json:"id"`
	Username  string `json:"username"`
	CreatedAt string `json:"created_at"`
	IsAdmin   bool   `json:"is_admin"`
}

func (r *UserRepository) FindByID(id int) (*UserResult, error) {
	return &UserResult{
		ID:        id,
		Username:  "jdoe",
		CreatedAt: "2025-01-10",
		IsAdmin:   false,
	}, nil
}

func GetUserHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	repo := &UserRepository{}
	user, err := repo.FindByID(42)
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}

	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(user)
}
